name: Eithne Úathach

attributes.attribute: cannibal woman who grew more beautiful the more infant flesh she devoured

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Eithne Úathach, also called Eithne the Horrible, was a cannibal woman in Irish legend. She grew more beautiful with each infant whose flesh she devoured. Horror and beauty merge in her terrible form.
